A2.claim: Same locally pinned endpoint/project identities; not a new server attestation.

A6.claim: Historical backup/restore success plus documented session-mode support; full per-tool trust/capacity contract not approved.

futureProbeDesigns.name: DIRECT_ENDPOINT_NETWORK_PROBE
preconditions: Operator-supplied exact official direct hostname/port and project identity
Reviewed CA/hostname contract and fixed target
allowed: DNS only for the supplied endpoint
bounded TCP connection and PostgreSQL SSLRequest/TLS handshake only
certificate CA/hostname validation and safe protocol/cipher metadata
